# Security Incident Policy

Employees must report suspected security incidents immediately.

## Reporting procedure

1. Contact the security team.
2. Record the time the incident was discovered.
3. Do not delete affected files.

## Severity levels

| Severity | Description | Response time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Critical | Active compromise | 15 minutes |
| High | Suspected compromise | 1 hour |

### After-hours incidents

Use the emergency security hotline outside business hours.
